compression_format.description: Compression format to use when feathering files; corresponds to -gz (gzip), -I (bzip2), -lz (lzip), -xz (xz), -Z (compress), -zip (zip), or -z (gzip with .z suffix)

file_mode.description: chmod mode to apply to created tar+feather files (e.g., 'go-rwx', '644', '-'); '-' means no chmod

list_created.description: List names of created files/directories after processing; -L suppresses listing

list_only.description: Only list table of contents (do not modify files); corresponds to -t option

preserve_modes.description: Pass -p flag to tar when untarring (preserve file modes/ownership); default is true (-p)

suffix_style.description: Suffix style for created tar+feather files (e.g., .tgz, .tar.gz); does not affect compression program

verbose.description: Enable verbose output (compression ratios, etc.); default is true (report); -V for non-verbose
